description: Chúng mình là một nhóm trẻ, sáng tạo và sẵn sàng cùng nhau khám phá, học hỏi để biến những ý tưởng thành sản phẩm thực tế. Nhóm mong muốn tìm kiếm những thành viên có tinh thần trách nhiệm, khả năng làm việc nhóm và không ngại thử sức với những điều mới. Nếu bạn muốn cùng trao đổi ý tưởng, phát huy khả năng của mình và tạo nên một dự án ý nghĩa, chúng mình rất mong được đồng hành cùng bạn!
summary:
Project Hear The Earth is an interactive web/mobile platform that transforms NASA’s open Earth observation data—such as climate changes, seismic activity, ocean currents, and atmospheric shifts—into expressive soundscapes and music (data sonification).
To address the challenge of making complex environmental data accessible, our tool translates real-time satellite datasets into intuitive audio patterns. Users can explore different regions of the globe and literally "listen" to how our planet's ecosystems are changing over time.
This project is important because raw scientific data can often feel overwhelming or abstract to the general public. By engaging the sense of hearing, Hear The Earth creates a deeper emotional connection with our planet, empowers visually impaired individuals to experience Earth science, and raises urgent awareness about climate change and environmental conservation.
details:
Hear the Earth is an interactive web application ("Earth Jukebox") that transforms visual frames and Earth science data from NASA's Earth Information Center (EIC) into real-time soundscapes (data sonification). The system analyzes visual elements—such as color spectrums, brightness, and pixel density—and maps them onto musical parameters including pitch, rhythm, tempo, and instrument timbre.

Benefits & Intended Impact:
Our solution makes complex climate and Earth science data more accessible, engaging, and emotionally resonant through a multi-sensory experience. Specifically, it empowers blind and visually impaired audiences to explore NASA’s visual datasets, while helping the general public intuitively feel and understand planetary changes through sound.

Tools, Coding Languages & Software Used:

  • Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment: Hosted and deployed globally on the edge using Cloudflare Pages , utilizing Cloudflare Workers for fast serverless routing, caching, and handling media assets with ultra-low latency.
  • Frontend & Audio Synthesis: Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, leveraging the Canvas API and Web Audio API (or Tone.js) to extract pixel data from NASA's open-access EIC imagery and synthesize real-time musical audio directly in the browser.

Creativity & Key Considerations:
Instead of converting raw data into harsh, random noise, we designed harmonic rules and musical scales so the generated audio is pleasant to listen to while remaining scientifically faithful to the underlying data. We also prioritized accessibility by ensuring screen-reader compatibility and adding descriptive text summaries for each sonified track.
